items.title: Pudgy Penguins-backed Abstract to shut down after ‘tens of millions’ in losses
items.snippet: Igloo CEO Luca Netz said the company funded Abstract for 18 months but still failed to find product-market fit despite attracting major brands and a community of millions.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо загального ринку -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.
